guards.name: frame parity
guards.statistic: max abs diff over an 11 x 11 lattice, m

guards.name: ring self-consistency
guards.statistic: max abs diff p vs to_local(lonlat), m
guards.rule: north-up < 0.05 m and the mirrored copy is far off

guards.name: buildings vs water (v2 rule)
guards.evidence: Overture water polygons without footprint-coincident ones (OSM; independent of BAG)
guards.statistic: share of footprint area on water at 1 m; north-up, its +-10/20 m shifts and its mirrored copy
guards.rule: north <= 1% or below 0.95x every shift, and mirrored >= 1.5x; the mirrored and 180-degree candidates must FAIL the same rule (rot3deg is recorded)

detail.note: fewer than 2 Wikidata landmarks in this sheet; the city-level G4 over the assembled sheets covers it

guards.name: heights vs AHN nDSM (v2 rule)
guards.evidence: AHN4 dsm_05m - dtm_05m (ground under buildings filled from the nearest valid DTM), p70 inside each footprint
guards.statistic: Spearman rho over buildings that stood before the AHN4 survey, and the share of all compared buildings within 2 m
guards.rule: rho >= 0.8 and share within 2 m >= 0.6; mirror, rot180 and a 10 m shift must FAIL the same rule

detail.note: AHN4 (2020-22) vs AHN5-dominated 3D BAG heights: buildings from 2020 on are not in the correlation (the nDSM cannot see them)

guards.name: terrain registration (v2 rule)
guards.evidence: the AHN DTM nodata mask (no ground points under buildings or water)
guards.statistic: Cohen's kappa of the DTM nodata mask vs rasterised footprints + water at 2 m, inside the square
guards.rule: kappa >= 0.5; >= 2x the larger of the mirrored and 180-degree kappa (floored at 0.1); and above every copy shifted 10/20 m east or north (either sign) or turned 3 degrees either way (gated)

guards.name: surface raster (v2 rule)
guards.evidence: Overture water polygons (OSM; independent of Sentinel-2)
guards.statistic: correlation of the water mask with -albedo from the exported PNG (row 0 = north); north-up, mirrored, turned 180 degrees
guards.rule: north >= 0.2 and >= 1.5x both copies; the mirrored and turned candidates must FAIL the same rule

guards.name: export orientation
guards.rule: equal; the unflipped compare must differ

waterLevel.reference: Amsterdam canals are held near NAP -0.40 m in summer (zomerpeil); that figure is NOT verified here, so this block records what the data say and gates nothing
